observations: Close-up of a keyboard/arranger workstation control panel and screen.
Screen shows MAIN menu with SONG, STYLE, VOICE fields: '008 BeatModern', '001 AlvFever', '001 Live! Grand Piano'.

Printed panel lists Music Database categories (POP, ROCK, BALLAD, R&B, JAZZ, DANCE, LATIN, COUNTRY, DISCO&PARTY, BALLROOM, TRADITIONAL, PIANIST, CHILDREN, WALTZ, FLASH MEMORY/USB) and VOICE list (PIANO, E.PIANO, ORGAN, ACCORDION, GUITAR, STRINGS, SAXOPHONE, TRUMPET).
Buttons visible: SONG, STYLE, VOICE, EASY SONG ARRANGER, START/STOP, SYNC START, PAUSE, CLEAR, REGIST MEMORY, BANK.
A 'Yamaha' logo is partially visible at the bottom edge of the photo.
Watermark overlay reads 'POSTED ON JIJI SEUNSTICS ENTERPRISE'.
No full view of the instrument's body, keys, ports, power brick, or a legible model number/sticker.
No image of the item powered on and producing sound, or of its physical condition (scratches, missing keys, etc.).

claims.claim: We deal on quality musical instruments/gears.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of business history, stock, or quality grading; this is a generic seller statement.

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, which drives price tier heavily among Yamaha arranger keyboards (e.g. PSR vs Tyros class).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full unit showing the model name/number printed on the body or a rear/bottom serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest plausible Yamaha arranger keyboard tier consistent with this panel style

risks.risk: Functional state (power-on, sound output, key response, screen backlight) cannot be confirmed from a static screen photo.
risks.proof: A short video of the keyboard powering on, keys being pressed, and audio playing through speakers or headphones.

risks.risk: Physical condition of keys, casing, and ports is not shown.
risks.proof: Full-body photos from front, back, and both sides, plus close-ups of keys and ports.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (power adapter, music stand, sustain pedal) unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of all items included in the sale laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Watermark suggests this may be a stock/reposted photo rather than the actual unit for sale.
risks.proof: A fresh photo from the seller with a handwritten date/name note or timestamp visible.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full keyboard body showing the printed model name/number (e.g., on the front panel or rear label).
Video of the unit powering on, a key being played, and sound output.
Photos of all sides of the unit and included accessories (adapter, stand, pedal).
A fresh, unwatermarked photo proving current possession of the actual item.
response.reason: Only the Yamaha brand is legible; the specific model that sets the price tier is not visible, and there is no proof of working condition, completeness, or physical state.
